title: Concept: Credential compared to a literal (java) — review required
description: Comparing a credential to a source literal (password.equals("s3cret-x")) bakes the secret into every checkout and build. The remedy is loading the expected value from a secret manager or KDF-verified hash.
applicability: java authentication checks; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Exposed secrets and unrotatable credentials; MEDIUM severity, HIGH when the literal guards production.
